project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Storage)
build_system: pnpm + Next.js 14 (next build). Package manager: pnpm@9.0.0. No Prisma — uses @supabase/supabase-js directly. Tailwind CSS v4 with tw-animate-css.
test_framework: No dedicated test framework configured. Verification is via pnpm run build (next build) and pnpm run type-check (tsc --noEmit).
verification_instructions: 1. Run `pnpm run type-check` — must pass with zero errors. 2. Run `pnpm run build` — must complete without errors. 3. Run `pnpm run lint` to check for lint issues.
environment_constraints: Windows (PowerShell). Only 3 env vars set: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Email env vars (GMAIL_USER, GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD, ADMIN_EMAIL) are missing — email features will fail at runtime but this is out of scope for these fixes. SQL migrations must be applied manually in Supabase SQL Editor — no supabase CLI migration runner is in use.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code style. All new pages must export `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` and `revalidate = 0`. Admin pages must call `requireAdmin()` or `getCurrentAdmin()` for auth guard. Client components need `'use client'` directive at top.
key_patterns: 1. Server components fetch via `createClient()` from `@/lib/supabase/server`. Client components use `createClient()` from `@/lib/supabase/client`. 2. Server actions live in `lib/supabase/` (e.g., settings-actions.ts, content-actions.ts) with `'use server'` directive. 3. Client form components extracted as separate files (e.g., site-settings-form.tsx) and imported into server-component page.tsx — this is the required pattern for forms. 4. Toast notifications via `sonner` (`toast.success`, `toast.error`). 5. UI components from `@/components/ui/*` (shadcn). 6. Lucide icons throughout. 7. All admin pages use tailwind classes like `rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-6`. 8. Public pages use slate/blue color palette matching about/services pages.
directory_structure: app/ — Next.js App Router pages. app/api/ — API routes. app/admin/(dashboard)/ — all admin pages behind route group. app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/ — settings sub-pages (site/, homepage/ exist; 6 others missing). lib/supabase/ — server actions and Supabase client helpers. components/ — shared React components including header.tsx (public nav). supabase/schema/ — SQL schema files (applied manually in Supabase SQL Editor). supabase/migrations/ — SQL migration files (also applied manually). .agents/tasks/ — workflow artifacts directory.
